experiment: E127 ls_start_faith: why the least-squares start reads worse than do-nothing under E34's adversarial check
code: experiments/ls_start_faith/run.py (job, config and these rules: source, exposure, random_masks, cancellation, score); cluster/ls_start_faith.sbatch
measurement: ratio = (PGD KL at the state, summed over the two 128-row blocks of Pile val rows 0-255, one seed-0 adversary per block, 20 sign steps of 0.1, bf16 autocast, faithfulness.harness_pgd) / (the same at W0, same job). A held read ('|hold') holds every alive subcomponent's mask at 1 (harness_pgd hold=) and divides by W0 read under the same hold. Random-mask ratio = faithfulness(pgd_steps=0) stochastic_kl (uniform-k-subset routing, continuous masks, 2 draws, Delta included) at the state over W0's, row-weighted over the two blocks. Relative to W0; 1 = no change.

rules.floor: f = 0.20877548446862537, the L40 W0 PGD floor over adversary seeds 0-2 (teacher_training_amend8c.json W0.pgd_floor), E34's noise scale for one ratio
rules.A source (per task): Xf = r(nothing_start) - r(nothing), Xp = r(start) - r(nothing_start). Xf carries if Xf >= f r(nothing) and Xf > 0; Xp carries if Xp >= f r(nothing_start) and Xp > 0. Both -> 'both'; Xf only -> 'function' (start's own weight change S, not dW, makes the excess); Xp only -> 'placement' (the same function reads worse with its change on the subcomponents than in Delta); neither -> 'within the floor'. A state missing -> 'not run'; non-finite -> 'invalid'.
rules.B exposure (per task, only if A is place: H = 1 - (r_hold(start) - r_hold(nothing_start)) / Xp. H >= 0.75 -> 'the alive masks' (the adversary's freedom over the alive masks carries the placement excess); H <= 0.25 -> 'not the alive masks'; between -> 'partly'. W0|hold mean block KL < 0.05 -> 'unreadable'; a held read missing -> 'not run'; else 'does not apply'.
rules.C random masks (per task, only if A is p: q = rr(start) / rr(nothing_start) - 1, rr the random-mask ratio. q >= f -> 'random masks see it'; else 'adversary only'. rr(nothing_start) <= 0 or non-finite -> 'invalid'.
rules.D cancellation (per task, weight side): kappa = ||sum_c D_c||^2 / sum_c ||D_c||^2 over the alive subcomponents' changes D_c = u'v'^T - uv^T, input-weighted (tr(A Sigma A^T), Sigma = W0's input second moment on the check's 256 rows), pooled over matrices; Frobenius (cancel.coherence) reported beside. A state cancels if kappa < 0.5. start and the least-squares-start copy cancel and the standard copy does not -> 'tracks the failing states'; else 'does not track'. Missing -> 'not run'; non-finite (no change) -> 'invalid'. Descriptive: it says whether cancellation is present where the failures are, not that it causes them.
